_meta.rule: No new facts. Every string is the site's own (verbatim, trimmed or restated, as `edit` says), with its fact ID (`src`, scripts-method.md §2) and site key (`key`). Re-check every string against assets/app.js at the render commit. No URL, email, phone number, ref code, price figure or call to action on screen. « Payé jusqu'ici : 0 DA » (prev.tl5d + .ptl-zero) is a price figure and is never used.

_meta.use_rule: `use` names cut prefixes: v02 = every cut; v02-s = the 9:16 short cut (both variants); v02-y = the 16:9 YouTube cut (both variants); v02-s-a / v02-y-a = variant A only. The copy loader refuses a block whose `use` does not match the cut.

_meta.typography: French strings keep the site's own no-break spaces: U+00A0 in « 24 h », « 5 jours », « 30 min » and U+202F before « : » (prev.tl5p), so a line never breaks inside them.

nobreak.note: Fixed phrases kept on one line at render time (copy.js keepTogether: span.nobr, white-space: nowrap; the strings are unchanged). V02's own list, passed to applyNobreak(); V01's list is not affected. T67 also uses data-keep="·" so it breaks at its separator, which is then hidden (markSeparatorBreaks).

_meta.words: Words are whitespace-separated tokens; « · », « — », « & » and « : » standing alone are not counted (the V01 convention, scripts-trailer.md §4.3).
